# `agents/gate-analyst.ts`

## Overview

The `gate-analyst` module provides utilities for analyzing gate decision patterns across tasks. It identifies recurring rejection patterns and proposes anti-pattern learnings to improve future gate outcomes.

---

## Types & Interfaces

### `GateAnalystResult`

Represents the structured output of a gate analysis, containing detected patterns and their associated learning proposals.

```typescript
interface GateAnalystResult {
  patterns: {
    description: string;
    occurrences: number;
    learning: {
      scope: string;
      category: string;
      content: string;
      tags: string[];
      confidence: number;
    };
  }[];
}
```

#### Members

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `patterns` | `array` | List of detected gate decision patterns |
| `patterns[].description` | `string` | Human-readable description of the detected pattern |
| `patterns[].occurrences` | `number` | Number of times this pattern has been observed |
| `patterns[].learning.scope` | `string` | The scope to which the proposed learning applies |
| `patterns[].learning.category` | `string` | Category classification of the learning |
| `patterns[].learning.content` | `string` | The body of the proposed anti-pattern learning |
| `patterns[].learning.tags` | `string[]` | Tags associated with the learning |
| `patterns[].learning.confidence` | `number` | Confidence score for the proposed learning |

## Functions

### `analyzeGatePatterns`

```typescript
async function analyzeGatePatterns(
  taskId: string,
  verdict: string,
  reasoning: string,
  repoFullName?: string
): Promise<void>
```

Analyzes recent gate decisions for patterns of repeated rejections. If patterns are found, proposes anti-pattern learnings.

> **Note:** This function is a named export and can be imported directly.

```typescript
import { analyzeGatePatterns } from '...';
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `taskId` | `string` | Yes | The identifier of the task associated with the gate decision |
| `verdict` | `string` | Yes | The gate verdict to record and analyze |
| `reasoning` | `string` | Yes | The reasoning behind the gate verdict |
| `repoFullName` | `string` | No | The full repository name (e.g. `owner/repo`) to scope the analysis |

#### Returns

`Promise<void>`

#### Example

```typescript
import { analyzeGatePatterns } from '...';

await analyzeGatePatterns(
  'task-abc123',
  'rejected',
  'Missing test coverage for edge cases',
  'my-org/my-repo'
);
```

### `parseGateAnalystResult`

```typescript
function parseGateAnalystResult(text: string): GateAnalystResult
```

Parses raw text output into a structured [`GateAnalystResult`](#gateanalystresult) object.

> **Note:** This function is not a named export from the module.

```typescript
import { parseGateAnalystResult } from '...';
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `text` | `string` | Yes | Raw text to parse into a `GateAnalystResult` |

#### Returns

[`GateAnalystResult`](#gateanalystresult) — the structured result parsed from the provided text.

#### Example

```typescript
import { parseGateAnalystResult } from '...';

const result: GateAnalystResult = parseGateAnalystResult(rawAnalysisText);

for (const pattern of result.patterns) {
  console.log(pattern.description, pattern.occurrences);
}
```
